args.body:
Dear Tailspin Ltd,

We have processed a refund of 175 for the conversion loss resulting from the invoice issued in the wrong currency. This refund has been tagged as 'Conversion Loss' for accounting purposes.

Please allow a few business days for the funds to appear in your account. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to reach out.

Best regards,
Customer Support Team
